prompts.lyrics:
Write original song lyrics for a new song.
Song title and theme: Antlercover
Musical style: Latin Flare: salsa-pop, syncopated congas, timbales, piano montuno, warm brass, melodic sung lead
Mood: Hopeful
Target length: about 60 seconds, roughly 15 short lines.
Return only the lyrics: original, plain, one line per verse line, no section headings, no song title, no commentary. English.
Original story brief: An anthropomorphic moose in Alaska works at a small local company during the long winter. He earnestly tries to fit in with human coworkers, keeps his huge antlers discreet, and avoids attracting local hunters. Funny, odd and affectionate rather than scary. Give him concrete office moments (a desk, coffee, meetings or snow boots), a memorable hopeful refrain and a warm ending where he finds belonging. No graphic violence, no artist imitation and no borrowed lyrics.
prompts.music: Latin Flare: salsa-pop, syncopated congas, timbales, piano montuno, warm brass, melodic sung lead. Style-matched vocals, supplied lyrics. Mood: Hopeful. Theme: Antlercover. Genre-led groove, tempo, instruments and production; Theme/mood shape dynamics and motifs.
prompts.cover: Original square cinematic storybook illustration, full-bleed scene. A hopeful anthropomorphic Alaska moose with huge antlers wears a plaid office shirt and sits slightly awkwardly at a small company desk with an unmarked coffee mug. Friendly human coworkers welcome him; his antlers blend comically into a coat rack and winter branches. Large windows show snowy mountains, deep-blue winter dusk and a tiny distant pair of outdoor figures in orange parkas walking past without noticing him. Warm amber office light, vibrant coral and turquoise accents and festive paper garlands suggest a playful Latin salsa-pop rhythm against the snowy Alaska scene. Expressive kind face, charming absurdity, hopeful belonging, detailed painterly animation aesthetic. Pure wordless visual artwork: no lettering, typography, labels, writing, captions, signs, logos or readable marks anywhere. Blank papers and blank building facades.

payload.lyrics:
Snow boots heavy on the linoleum floor
I tuck my crown behind the office door
Coffee steam rises in the cold gray light
Trying to blend in, keeping it tight
The boss calls a meeting, I stand up straight
Praying my antlers don’t meet his fate
A gentle nod from Sarah down the hall
She sees the moose, not just the wall
We laugh at jokes that only we understand
In this small town across the land
No hunters here, just hearts beating true
My place is here, and so are you
The winter fades with a salsa beat
Warm brass swells beneath my feet
I am home, finally seen
